title: ID0412812-DC/Si-D/DE[170003980] - QR Code issue and Idle logo not showing
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The QR code for the CCV receipt server (https://receipt.ccvdeutschland.de:8009/search?lang=de) displayed on the screen after the update doesn't work. It looks as if there is no URL behind the QR code. Furthermore, the customer logo on the display board is gone after the update.
Solution
: QR Code worked on the charger in Corroios factory, it seems like a mobile issue or sudden disconnection from CCV server. For the idle logo, it's no longer usable as per v6.1.3 where it's removed

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0412812-DC/Si-D/DE[170003980] - QR Code issue and Idle logo not showing CRM:00315002443, Ticket 0412812
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
Thank you for your emails. As long as the QR code contains an incorrect URL, end customers will not be able to use it. A video of this issue seems somewhat pointless.
Here is the situation: The end customer arrives with their vehicle and wants to charge. If they have charged using their bank card, they must be given the option to obtain a receipt for the charging session.
Since your update, the "final screen" after a successful charge displays the message "Your Receipt" along with the mentioned QR code. When the end customer takes out their phone to scan the QR code to retrieve their receipt, nothing happens. Nothing will happen until the correct URL is embedded:
✅
Correct URL:
https://receipt.ccv-deutschland.de:8009/search?lang=de
Therefore, I kindly ask you to update the QR code with the correct URL. Once this is done, the issue will be resolved.
Thank you for sharing the idea of the screen. Does the customer have the option to choose between the screensaver and the standard screen? How would both screens behave? In other words, how can this be imagined in daily use for the end customer?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Anna Schreiner

additional_info.body:
Hello Anna, good afternoon.
Thank you for your patience so far.
I changed the URL from the QR code to the correct one. Can you please test it again? If it doesn't work I will then reinvestigate this in order to find the root cause.
The screensaver works in a way that
if the screen is not used in X seconds
(configurable),
it will show a default set of screensavers
.
There is a
maximum of 10 images
and there is a transition
period of 10sec
(default, also configurable).
If you have 10 images, it will
show each image
,
in a specific order that you wish
,
for 10sec
and then
moves to the next one
in line.
These screensavers have a
1920x1080
resolution and it's mandatory otherwise it doesn't work.
Usually, it's used to show in the screen some sort of advertisement or even show the prices of the energy for the customers to see.
Let me know your opinion and if the QR Code worked please!
Thank you very much and have a nice rest of the day.
Best regards,
Francisco
